optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Model Evaluation Engineer, Supply Chain Collaboration

professionalSummary.text: Maintains the backtest harness and holdout sets for demand-forecast models in collaboration with the forecasting team.
professionalSummary.witness: Maintained the backtest harness that replays twelve months of supplier order history per pilot customer and the holdout sets frozen per quarter, both under version control with the forecasting team.

professionalSummary.text: Publishes evaluation reports with per-customer error tables after running pre-release backtests for model versions.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the pre-release backtest for the three model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report with per-customer error tables.

professionalSummary.text: Documents backtest assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions for each model version.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote the backtest notes for each version, listing the holdout composition, the known limitation that promotional periods were excluded from the holdout, and the hand-over items for the next backtest.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated release decisions in the forecasting release meeting with the forecasting lead and customer operations.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated release decisions in the forecasting release meeting; the forecasting lead took the release decision and customer operations confirmed the rollout to each pilot customer.

experienceHighlights.text: Reported forecast accuracy improvements against the documented baseline using the frozen Q3 holdout set.
experienceHighlights.witness: Weighted forecast error on the four pilot customers fell from 24.5 percent to 17.8 percent between version 1.4 and version 2.0, on the frozen Q3 holdout set and against the documented version 1.4 baseline of 24.5 percent.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Provided per-version evaluation reports and backtest notes for version 2.0 as work samples, including harness run identifiers for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the per-version evaluation report (weighted error per pilot customer, baseline line, version markers) and the backtest notes for version 2.0, with the harness run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Backtest harness maintenance and holdout set management.
skills.witness: Maintained the backtest harness that replays twelve months of supplier order history per pilot customer and the holdout sets frozen per quarter, both under version control with the forecasting team.

skills.text: Pre-release backtest execution and evaluation report publication.
skills.witness: Ran the pre-release backtest for the three model versions released in the year and published the evaluation report with per-customer error tables.

skills.text: Documentation of backtest assumptions, limitations, and hand-over conditions.
skills.witness: Wrote the backtest notes for each version, listing the holdout composition, the known limitation that promotional periods were excluded from the holdout, and the hand-over items for the next backtest.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's maintenance of the backtest harness and holdout sets, execution of pre-release backtests, publication of evaluation reports, documentation of backtest details, and coordination of release decisions. The materials do not establish the candidate's direct ownership of forecast accuracy improvements, the specific metrics of forecast accuracy improvement, or the candidate's role in the release decision-making process beyond coordination.
